Although Matt Gaetz was vice chairman of the board during part of the time the fraud allegedly occurred, he has stated that he had no direct role in the fraud and was not a party to the lawsuit.

questions.question: Are there any other notable cases of hospice fraud similar to the one involving Matt Gaetz?

answers.answer: Yes, there are notable cases of hospice fraud similar to the one involving Matt Gaetz, including a major scheme in California that defrauded $267 million from Medi-Cal and involved 21 suspects being charged.

questions.question: What was the amount paid in hospice fraud by the company associated with Republican Matt Gaetz?
What is the official source for the figure of 75 million in hospice fraud?

answers.answer: The official source for the figure of 75 million in hospice fraud is the U.S. Department of Justice, which reported that Chemed Corp. and Vitas Hospice Services agreed to pay $75 million to resolve allegations of submitting false claims to Medicare for hospice services.
